messages:
maya.prod: FYI — sales flagged a customer asking for a 99.99% uptime clause + 50ms p95 latency for inference. They want a proposal by EOW.

sam.sales: Customer is a fintech with PCI scope, pushing for dedicated capacity and 24/7 support. They said uptime must be contractual.

jordan.support: Can we get details on traffic patterns? sustained RPS or bursty? Also which endpoints (generation vs embeddings)?

sam.sales: Mostly generation, peak windows 9-11am PST and 4-6pm PST, ~120 qps peak, avg 20 qps.

li.eng: 120 qps generation at 50ms p95 is aggressive on a single pinned model. Need to know model size + willingness to accept quantization/approx models.

olivia.sre: For contractual 99.99% we need runbook + multi-region fallback. Who owns incident escalation (SRE vs Customer Success)?

maya.prod: Trade-offs: SLA terms drive Dedicated commitment and higher support tier. Proposed path: intake -> feasibility + cost -> proposed SLA + rollout plan.

intake-bot: New intake created: #INC-2028. Fields: customer=AcmeFin, requested_slo=99.99% uptime, latency_p95=50ms, traffic_profile=120qpspeak, endpoints=generation, deadline=2026-03-27.

jordan.support: Suggest we ask customer if 99.9% acceptable with technical mitigations (cold start warmers, autoscale buffers). 99.99% is 4.38 mins/year — very tight.

li.eng: Agreed. Also need to know tolerance for fallbacks to smaller model (latency ok, quality drop). If they accept fallback, achievable. Otherwise cost + infra jumps.

sam.sales: I'll push back on 99.99 and ask if 99.95 would be acceptable. They're willing to pay for reserved capacity.

maya.prod: Action items: sam -> confirm acceptance floor (99.95 vs 99.99) by EOD Tue; li -> run quick perf/cost estimate for 120 qps gen at 50ms p95 across model variants; olivia -> draft minimal multi-region runbook and escalation matrix.

li.eng: I'll run a perf sweep tomorrow morning. Quick note: include KV cache and batching in estimates.

olivia.sre: Drafting escalation matrix now. Proposed routing:
```
- P0 (service down / SLO breach): paged to oncall SRE -> page SRE lead -> escalate to eng lead after 15m
- P1 (degraded latency): routed to eng-platform + support; success manager notified
- Contact: 24/7 phone for P0, email + pager for P1
```

maya.prod: For product backlog intake: we should create a dedicated epic "enterprise-slo-intake/AcmeFin" and tag with "sales-priority" + "sla-contract". Keep scope minimal for initial commit: dedicated pool + region failover + 24/7 pager.

sam.sales: Customer asked about penalties. We'll propose credit-based SLA (standard). Legal will review.

jordan.support: Template response for now: "Thanks — we'll assess feasibility and return a proposed architecture, cost, and timeline. Could you confirm if 99.95% would be acceptable as an alternative?"

maya.prod: Sounds good. I'll own the epic and schedule a triage meeting Thurs 10am. If perf numbers look bad, we surface trade-offs and optional add-ons (hot-cache reserve, FPGA instances).

li.eng: One more thing: include CI eval set for quality regression if we propose fallback models. Need customer's sample prompts.

sam.sales: I'll request a sample prompt set and confirm credit willingness.

maya.prod: OK — closing loop: intake logged (#INC-2028), actions assigned. Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
